# SPD-024 — Team card design doc: token prose after SPD-021 and SPD-023

## Brief
`docs/design/2026-09-12-team-card.md` describes the token columns as they were before [[SPD-021]] and [[SPD-023]]: a transcript sum over every assistant message, a foreground completion that overwrites the sum, and Pompadour's and Sarpo's per-entry figures. Since SPD-021 a completion is kept under `usage_json.completion` and never becomes `total_tokens`; since SPD-023 a sum counts each API request once, by its last entry, marked `"counting": "request"`, and `spud member resum` re-summed the live rows on 2026-09-13. Update the eight stale lines (134, 135, 136, 137, 147, 165, 169 and case 16 at line 644) in place, each marked with the ticket that changed it, from the members' Results and the live ledger.

## Size, persona and model decision
One writer on sonnet, the persona tier, no children, in the main checkout: the deliverable is a doc, and docs live on `main`, so no worktree. No Fable (Eric, 2026-09-13). The figures come from the live ledger after Spud's `member resum --all`, and what each line should now say from Chieftain's and Pompadour's Results. Spud reads the diff at return and commits it on `main`.
